title: Environment, secret and sandbox-account provisioning automation — verification evidence record
environment: sandboxed worker pod (no cloud credentials, no PostgreSQL server, no Docker)
doctrine: Every live-provider operation that could not run in the worker pod is listed NOT RUN with its owner. Nothing in this record claims a live result. The plan-mode provision path and the local artifact convergence are fully verified without credentials; the credentialed re-run (Lead) owns the live application of the provider plan (deploy/PUBLIC-DEPLOYMENT.md sections 3.2 + 8).

notRun.check: Neon project/branch creation per the deterministic resource plan (preview/staging/production classes)
notRun.reason: No NEON_API_KEY in the worker pod; the tool records the step not-run with its credential variable and never performs provider control-plane calls.

notRun.check: Cloudflare R2 bucket / Queues / Workflows resource creation per the deterministic plan
notRun.reason: No CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN in the worker pod.

notRun.check: Upstash Redis resource creation per the deterministic plan
notRun.reason: No UPSTASH_API_KEY in the worker pod.

notRun.check: Vercel project creation per the deterministic plan
notRun.reason: No VERCEL_TOKEN in the worker pod.

notRun.check: Live materialization of secret-reference VALUES into an external secret manager / CI environment
notRun.reason: External-only doctrine by construction: the tool emits reference templates and CI variable skeletons only; values never transit it. The materialization itself is operator account-plane work.

notRun.check: PostgreSQL-backed integration suites (bootstrap/teardown over a real server)
notRun.reason: No PostgreSQL server available in the worker pod (no server binaries, no Docker); the suites skip cleanly without ZECK_PG_TEST_URL.
notRun.owner: Lead credentialed re-run (or any environment with a PostgreSQL 16+ server)

notRun.check: CI execution of the deployment-validation workflow (including the provision steps)
notRun.reason: Workers do not push to main; CI runs on the Lead's merge.

verifiedLocally.check: Deployment configuration validation including the new sandbox-accounts manifest (rule family 15, fail-closed)
Provision plan mode with ZERO credentials (AC1: manifest validation, resource plan, scaffold + records projection, nothing written)
verifiedLocally.evidence: exit 0; 5 documented steps PASS; 3 artifacts projected (all absent, nothing written); live provider steps: none for the local class

31 tests pass: first converge creates 3 artifacts, second run already-converged (0 created/repaired/pruned, 3 unchanged), corrupted/deleted/orphaned artifacts re-converge (1 repaired, 1 created, 1 pruned), post-convergence byte-comparison PASS

verifiedLocally.check: Teardown classification guards extend to the provisioned records (AC3)
verifiedLocally.evidence: local/preview remove exactly the computed provisioned directory (already-absent reported honestly on re-run); staging/production refused with 'refusing to remove provisioned records … classification, not operator intent'

plaintext in a reference variable aborts fail-closed in BOTH modes without echoing it; cross-environment references refused; planted credential values (NEON_API_KEY / CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN / ZECK_PG_ADMIN_URL / VERCEL_TOKEN / UPSTASH_API_KEY) never reach the report, the artifacts or the real-process CLI stdout/stderr; scaffold artifacts carry zeck-secret:// references only

verifiedLocally.check: Sandbox-account records are a pure manifest projection (AC4)
verifiedLocally.evidence: policy facts (synthetic-data classes == the frozen platform artifact, quota dimensions from the budgets vocabulary, guard thresholds RESOLVED from quota-guards.json, DEP-014 TTL/reset/post-expiry) trace to manifest rows; byte-identical deterministic renders; an edited manifest row flows through the projection

verifiedLocally.check: Fail-closed validation of malformed sandbox-accounts rows (before any provider call or write)
verifiedLocally.evidence: 17 malformed-row classes abort the parser (invalid JSON, schema drift, unknown/missing environments, authoritative-class accounts, empty disposable class, drifted policy classes, unknown dimension/window/guard, non-integer limits, contradicting platform-default TTL, non-DEP-014 reset/post-expiry modes, malformed/duplicate ids)

verifiedLocally.check: Governance / typecheck / lint / unit / architecture / integration batteries
verifiedLocally.command: python3 scripts/governance-check.py && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test:unit && bun run test:architecture && bun run test:integration
verifiedLocally.evidence: recorded in the DEP-002 worker report (2-a) — all green at the branch head; PG suites skip honestly without ZECK_PG_TEST_URL

notes: The sandbox-account records are provisioning policy facts (synthetic-data policy, quota envelope, expiry semantics) projected from deploy/manifests/sandbox-accounts.json — not runtime identities. Runtime sandbox identity lifecycle stays governed by the DEP-014 platform surface (src/modules/sandbox + apps/dashboard/sandbox-governance.ts).

The manifest is fail-closed against the platform authorities: synthetic-data classes must EQUAL the frozen artifact, quota dimensions/windows come from the budgets module's closed vocabularies, guard wiring must exist in quota-guards.json, platform-default TTLs must equal SANDBOX_IDENTITY_DEFAULT_TTL_MS.

Live-provider steps are gated on credential PRESENCE only (never values); with credentials present the plan is marked executable-plan for the credentialed operator application path — this tool performs no provider control-plane calls (provider-neutrality doctrine).
